newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan October industrial output up 5.07 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan October industrial output up 5.07 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Taiwan's industrial output in October rose 5.07 percent compared with October 1995, the economics ministry said on Wednesday.
In month-on-month terms, October industrial output was up 2.38 percent from September, the ministry said.
The manufacturing index, which includes metals, machinery, information electronics, chemical and consumer products, rose 6.17 percent in October from the same month in 1995.
Real estate and construction industry output in October fell 17 percent from a year earlier. Mining industry output was down 2.27 percent year on year.
